properties.description:
BUILT AND VERIFIED 2026-10-29 (commit 94ecdda9c: call_can_give_the_owners_word in service.rs, decision_landing_hint and replace_text in tools/capture.rs), increment 2. The pilot's commonest cue (set_decision_status, 101 offered, 5 followed) came from two replies: add_decision's "a Decision lands `proposed` — only the owner's word moves it (set_decision_status)" (25) and replace_text's "if the change is a settlement, set_decision_status carries the owner's word" (76). A solo agent recording someone else's project cannot give that word, so the cue named a call that was never its to make (fact:in-the-recall-pilot-agents-followed-4-percent-of-reflow2s-cues-within-five-calls-2026-10-29).

THE RULE, kept small: the call can give the owner's word when it is made FOR a named contributor (the request's or session's writes_for, which behind a gateway is the verified caller) and, where the design names its owner (a Project OWNED_BY a Contributor), that contributor is one of them; a design naming no owner takes a named caller at their word (approval is checked where it is written anyway). Otherwise both hints say what the cue is: a question for the owner, put to them with ask_question, not the agent's next call — and they no longer name set_decision_status, so it is not counted as offered. Additive: the field and its other wordings are unchanged.

Distinct from the counting capability: that one measures cues; this one changes who a cue is addressed to. A cue its reader cannot act on measures nothing but noise.
properties.name: A cue that asks for the owner's word is offered as the agent's next call only when the call is made for the design's owner; otherwise it says it is a question for the owner
